div.head: VII Atr 2.3a
div.ab: Hii sunt illi tres dies: dies Lune, dies Martis et dies Mercurii proximi ante festum sancti Michaelis.
Hii sunt illi tres dies—dies Lunae, dies Martis et dies Mercurii proximi ante festum sancti Michaelis.
Hii sunt illi tres dies: dies Lunae, dies Martis, et dies Mercurii proximi ante festum sancti Michaelis.
Dies sind jene drei Tage: Montag, Dienstag und Mittwoch zunächst vor dem Michaelisfeste [29. September].
These are the three days: the Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday next before Michaelmas [29 September].
These are the three days—the Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday immediately preceding the feast of St Michael.
These are the three days: the Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday just before the Feast of Saint Michael.

note.seg: S. o. 2¹; Einl. 7. Der 29. Sept. kann (auch laut 7) nicht unter etwa 6 Wochen, schwerlich aber ein Vierteljahr mehr ferne sein
See above 2¹; Introduction 7. The 29th Sept. cannot (according to 7 as well) have been less than about 6 weeks off, but can hardly have been more than a quarter of a year off
